kjv: to the saints which are at Ephesus
mine: to the saints who are [in Ephesus]
note: en Epheso is absent from P46, Sinaiticus*, B*, 1739 and was unknown to Origen and Marcion's text; the letter may have been a circular. SBLGNT brackets it; the KJV prints it plainly.

kjv: your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints
mine: your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love toward all the saints
note: SBLGNT includes "ten agapen" with the TR; P46, Sinaiticus*, A, B omit it (making "faith … toward all the saints"). Divided evidence; listed for completeness.

kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened
mine: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened
note: TR "dianoias" against "kardias" (P46, Sinaiticus, A, B, D, F, G).
